name: Wei Zhang
bio:
Wei Zhang's journey in motorsport began with a fascination for engines, sparked by his father's work as a mechanic. He earned a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Tsinghua University and quickly found his calling in racing. Early on, he specialized in engine performance optimization, contributing to several championship-winning teams in Asian touring car series. His meticulous approach and relentless pursuit of marginal gains propelled him into leadership roles. 

Wei is known for his ability to diagnose complex mechanical issues swiftly and his unwavering commitment to detail. He joined Academy Motorsport seeking a new challenge, aiming to refine their engineering processes and elevate the team's technical capabilities. He believes in nurturing young talent and fostering a culture of continuous improvement, always pushing his team to explore innovative solutions while maintaining rigorous standards. 

What sets Wei apart is his pragmatic approach to problem-solving. He focuses on delivering tangible improvements, prioritizing reliability and performance gains over chasing fleeting trends. He also has an uncanny ability to 'hear' problems in an engine's sound, a skill honed over decades of experience.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with slight graying at the temples
physical.description: Wei is of average height with a wiry build, giving him a focused and intense appearance.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even to meetings.
Insists on double-checking all calculations, regardless of who performed them.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically against the table when deep in thought.
